tools.name: simplicate_list_organizations
tools.description: List CRM organizations (companies) with optional filters, e.g. filters {"name": "Acme*"}. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/crm/organization.

tools.name: simplicate_get_organization
tools.description: Get one CRM organization by id, including its addresses, relation type and account manager. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/crm/organization/{id}.

tools.name: simplicate_list_persons
tools.description: List CRM persons (people) with optional filters, e.g. filters {"family_name": "Jansen"}. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/crm/person.

tools.name: simplicate_get_person
tools.description: Get one CRM person by id. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/crm/person/{id}.

tools.name: simplicate_list_relation_types
tools.description: List the relation types (for example customer or supplier) that an organization can have. Use the ids when you create an organization. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/crm/relationtype.

tools.name: simplicate_list_sales
tools.description: List sales deals (pipeline opportunities) with optional filters. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/sales/sales.

tools.name: simplicate_get_sale
tools.description: Get one sales deal by id, including its status, value and organization. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/sales/sales/{id}.

tools.name: simplicate_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with optional filters, e.g. filters {"name": "Website*"}. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/projects/project.

tools.name: simplicate_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/projects/project/{id}.

tools.name: simplicate_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with optional filters, e.g. filters {"invoicestatus.id": "<id>"}. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/invoices/invoice.

tools.name: simplicate_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, including its lines, totals and status. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/invoices/invoice/{id}.

tools.name: simplicate_list_hours
tools.description: List hours registrations (time booked on projects) with optional filters, e.g. filters {"employee_id": "<id>"}. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/hours/hours.

tools.name: simplicate_list_employees
tools.description: List employees (colleagues) of the account. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/hrm/employee.

tools.name: simplicate_list_timeline_messages
tools.description: List timeline messages (notes, e-mails and log lines) on records, with optional filters. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/timeline/message.

tools.name: simplicate_list_timeline_message_types
tools.description: List the timeline message types. Use a type id when you create a timeline note. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/timeline/messagetype.

tools.name: simplicate_create_organization
tools.description: Create a CRM organization. Only the fields you pass are set. Simplicate API: POST /api/v2/crm/organization.

tools.name: simplicate_create_person
tools.description: Create a CRM person (not linked to an organization by this tool). Simplicate API: POST /api/v2/crm/person.

tools.name: simplicate_create_timeline_note
tools.description: Add a note to the timeline of an organization, person, project or sales deal. The note is written in the name of the signed-in user. Simplicate API: POST /api/v2/timeline/message.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: simplicate_list_timeline_messages, simplicate_list_timeline_message_types · Private data: simplicate_list_timeline_messages · Public sink: simplicate_create_organization, simplicate_create_person, simplicate_create_timeline_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: simplicate_list_timeline_messages, simplicate_list_timeline_message_types · Private data: simplicate_list_timeline_messages · Public sink: simplicate_create_organization, simplicate_create_person, simplicate_create_timeline_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
